title: Identification and characterisation of a novel EhOrc1/Cdc6 from the human pathogen Entamoeba histolytica: an in silico approach.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算模拟表征溶组织内阿米巴的Orc1/Cdc6蛋白，涉及蛋白结构建模、对接与模拟，但对象为DNA复制起始蛋白而非TF-DNA转录结合体系，方法可迁移但互作轴聚焦不足。
abstract: The onset of a pre-replication complex on origin commences DNA replication. The Origin recognition complex (Orc), Cell division cycle protein 6 (Cdc6), and the minichromosome maintenance (Mcm) replicative helicase, along with Chromatin licensing and DNA replication factor 1 (Cdt1), make up the pre-replication complex in eukaryotes. Eukaryotic Orc is made up of six subunits, designated Orc1-6 while monomeric Cdc6 has sequence similarity with Orc1. However, Orc has remained unexplored in the protozoan parasite Entamoeba histolytica. Here we report a single functional Orc1/Cdc6 protein in E. histolytica. Its structural and functional aspects have been highlighted by a detailed in silico analysis that reflects physicochemical characteristics, predictive 3D structure modelling, protein-protein interaction studies, molecular docking and simulation. This in silico study provides insight into EhOrc1/Cdc6 and points out that E. histolytica carries pre-replication machinery that is less complex than higher eukaryotes and closer to archaea. Additionally, it lays the groundwork for future investigations into the methods of origin recognition, and anomalies of cell cycle observed in this enigmatic parasite.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 复制前复合体在复制起点上的形成启动了DNA复制。在真核生物中，复制前复合体由起源识别复合体（Origin recognition complex, Orc）、细胞分裂周期蛋白6（Cell division cycle protein 6, Cdc6）、微小染色体维持（minichromosome maintenance, Mcm）复制解旋酶以及染色质许可和DNA复制因子1（Chromatin licensing and DNA replication factor 1, Cdt1）组成。真核生物的Orc由六个亚基组成，命名为Orc1-6，而单体Cdc6与Orc1具有序列相似性。然而，在原生动物寄生虫溶组织内阿米巴（Entamoeba histolytica）中，Orc尚未被探索。本文报道了溶组织内阿米巴中一个单一功能的Orc1/Cdc6蛋白。通过详细的计算机模拟分析，包括理化特性、预测的三维结构建模、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用研究、分子对接和模拟，突出了其结构和功能方面。这项计算机模拟研究深入了解了EhOrc1/Cdc6，并指出溶组织内阿米巴携带的复制前机制比高等真核生物更简单，更接近古菌。此外，它为未来研究该神秘寄生虫中起源识别方法和细胞周期异常奠定了基础。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
